{{Top|leg}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Itlar''' was a weapons collector and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]. Itlar owned a complete set of [[Ekkar Armaments]] weapons, including a [[coyn'skar]]. Itlar acquired the weapons during a visit to a [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]], and often got together with friends to duel with coyn'skars. Itlar commented on the entries for the coyn'skar, [[sat'skar]], [[auto-caster]], and [[BR1-Z]] [[blast-rifle]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dr. Itlar is referred to as Dr. '''Ithar''' in the entries for the [[sat'skar]] and [[Coynite battle armor]].
